## QuantFunc MiniMax-H3

QuantFunc runs the H3 transformer and joint video/audio sampling. CLIPLoader (type minimax), the VAEs, conditioning, scheduler and sampler are stock ComfyUI.

- Transformer: `minimax_h3_fl2va_4step_quantfunc_int4_r128.safetensors`, from [QuantFunc on ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/QuantFunc/Minimax-H3-Quantfunc-4bit), in models/diffusion_models.
- Text encoder: `qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors`. Video VAE: `minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors`. Audio VAE: `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors`, from [Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3).
- Saved canvas: 768x768, 124 frames.
- Saved sampling: 8 total steps, res_multistep / simple, denoise 1, attention sage.
- Saved seed: 42 (fixed).
- First/last frames: both inputs are enabled and use `minimax_h3_fl2va_beach_reference.png`. Either anchor is optional; with neither, this is text-to-video.

Single-stage sampling at the saved canvas size. Change the prompt, canvas and frame count in the H3 conditioning node.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a waist-up medium close-up of a young adult woman dancing on a beach at golden hour. She wears an ivory dress embroidered with delicate colorful flowers, with visible stitched texture across the bodice and sleeves. Her loose dark hair, sleeves, and skirt move naturally in the sea breeze. Warm sunlight illuminates her skin and the embroidery; ocean waves, wet sand, and the distant horizon form a softly blurred background. She performs a fluid dance with gentle shoulder rolls, torso sways, and graceful arm movements, keeping her hands within the frame. Over ten seconds, the camera smoothly orbits clockwise around her through a full 360-degree arc, traveling from the front to her profile, behind her, and back to the front. It maintains a constant distance and chest-level height, keeping her upper body centered and the horizon level. The sea and shoreline shift continuously through the background with natural parallax. She dances mostly in place, independently of the camera’s orbit. As the camera returns to the front, she finishes with a gentle shoulder accent and a relaxed smile toward the lens. One uninterrupted shot, smooth camera movement, consistent facial features and embroidered patterns, natural anatomy, sharp subject detail, and subtle motion blur in her hair and hands.

overall_soundscape: Gentle surf washes onto the sand beneath a light sea breeze. Soft fabric rustling accompanies her movements. No speech.

non_diegetic_music: A steady instrumental groove at 105 BPM, with warm bass, light percussion, and delicate acoustic guitar accents. The rhythm remains consistent and ends on a clean musical accent.
